title: 1.2 Plate Tectonics Theory
description: The lithosphere, asthenosphere, major plates, and the development of plate tectonic theory. Medium level.

questions.question: What does plate tectonic theory state about Earth outer layers?
options: The lithosphere is divided into plates that move on the asthenosphere
A comprehensive global framework convention to protect the atmosphere
It generates income while promoting low-emission regional development
Scientists doubted that so much drift could happen in so short a time
questions.correctAnswer: The lithosphere is divided into plates that move on the asthenosphere

questions.question: Why is plate tectonics considered a scientific revolution?
options: Cost-effective steps consistent with sustainable development
Short fluctuations do not represent a change in climate state
It provides a unifying explanation for many geologic features
Set voluntary emission targets and report progress regularly
questions.correctAnswer: It provides a unifying explanation for many geologic features

questions.question: Which observation shows that plates change over geologic time?
options: Two plates slide past each other
They move slowly and change size
They stay at fixed depths
They remain the same size
questions.correctAnswer: They move slowly and change size

questions.question: How does plate tectonics influence long-term climate?
options: It affects the composition of the atmosphere and oceans
By lowering emissions of heat-trapping greenhouse gases
It links crustal movement to the formation of landforms
A programme of work on adaptation and response measures
questions.correctAnswer: It affects the composition of the atmosphere and oceans

questions.question: Which events can plate tectonics help predict?
options: The Earth radius increases rapidly
It belongs to tectonic engineering
Plates form new crust continuously
Earthquakes and volcanic eruptions

questions.question: Which feature is explained by plate tectonic theory?
options: More frequent droughts and unpredictable rainfall
The distribution of fossils and the ages of rocks
They proved a volcanic origin for both continents
Reduce greenhouse gas emissions and enhance sinks
questions.correctAnswer: The distribution of fossils and the ages of rocks

questions.question: What is the relationship between continental crust and lithospheric plates?
options: Continental crust replaces the asthenosphere
Leapfrogging to modern and energy-efficient technologies
Continental crust forms a separate layer above the plates
Continental crust is embodied within lithospheric plates
questions.correctAnswer: Continental crust is embodied within lithospheric plates

questions.question: Why can plates move over the asthenosphere?
options: The asthenosphere is frozen solid
The asthenosphere contains ocean water
The asthenosphere is ductile and can flow
Warming has accelerated in recent decades
questions.correctAnswer: The asthenosphere is ductile and can flow

questions.question: Which statement about the North American Plate is accurate?
options: It ends exactly at the Atlantic coast
Sulfuric acid haze reflects incoming sunlight
It lies entirely in the Southern Hemisphere
It extends beneath part of the Atlantic Ocean
questions.correctAnswer: It extends beneath part of the Atlantic Ocean

questions.question: How does plate tectonics help in understanding mountain building?
options: It links crustal movement to the formation of landforms
By lowering emissions of heat-trapping greenhouse gases
They raise pastoralist incomes while limiting emissions
It records the temperature of mountain peaks
questions.correctAnswer: It links crustal movement to the formation of landforms
